cross_verification.note_en: The Embassy of Niger in Brussels (ambaniger-bruxelles.be), an official Nigerien diplomatic mission site, lists 'une photo d'identité récente en couleur' (a recent color ID photo) as a requirement across every visa category (official, student, medical, journalist, private, business) but gives no dimensions, background, or other technical specification. Niger's national e-government portal service-public.ne was unreachable (persistent 521 'server is down' error) throughout research, so its passeport/visa démarche pages could not be checked directly.
